Prompt:

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster built around the interaction between portrait photography, typography, structure, and physical space.

Subject: [male / female fashion model]
Outfit: [minimal tailoring / black fashion / white suit / structured styling]
Palette: [black + acid lime / ivory + burgundy / black + teal / custom palette]
Title: [TITLE]
Design direction: [oversized type / acrylic frame / vertical slicing / structural layout]

Start with a strong fashion photograph: realistic skin, refined facial features, expressive pose, detailed fabric, controlled studio lighting, and premium magazine quality.

Then make the graphic design physically interact with the subject instead of simply placing text around the portrait.

Directions:

• Oversized type × figure
Use extremely large typography that extends beyond the canvas. Let the subject pass in front of some letters and behind others, creating foreground/background depth.

• Acrylic form × spatial layering
Introduce a transparent glass or acrylic frame with visible thickness, reflections, edge highlights and subtle refraction. Let the subject touch, enter or intersect the structure.

• Vertical slices × portrait
Reconstruct one portrait through 4–5 unequal vertical image sections with visible gaps and subtle positional shifts. Keep the main facial features readable and attractive.

• Fashion × structural layout
Use a strong fashion pose, geometric color fields, oversized typography and architectural framing. Let the body, furniture, color blocks and type form one unified composition.

Keep typography bold but controlled: one dominant title, one short supporting phrase and minimal micro-text.

Use asymmetrical composition, strong scale contrast, intentional negative space, layering, cropping and selective color accents.

The final image should feel like a premium fashion campaign, experimental magazine cover or contemporary exhibition key visual.

Prompt:

Create a full-body 9:16 realistic fashion editorial featuring an adult young East Asian woman with a refined K-pop-inspired look, expressive eyes, a slim silhouette, and long balanced legs.

Use the uploaded image as a pose reference only. The model stands directly on real staircase steps, not on a concrete block, ledge, pedestal, or parapet.

One leg supports her weight naturally while the other bends backward, bringing the heel toward the body. One hand reaches back to lightly hold or adjust the heel, shoe opening, or ankle. This movement creates a natural twist through the waist and shoulders as she turns her head back toward the camera.

Keep strong eye contact with an expressive mood — playful, cool, confident, sensual, or slightly provocative — rather than a blank model expression.

Style the model with a fashion-forward mini dress or bodysuit featuring one clear design element, such as a deep-V neckline, sculpted bandeau, asymmetric shoulder, halter construction, or clean geometric cutout. Keep the outfit sharp and minimal rather than adding too many straps or decorative details.

Use refined fashion hosiery with a clear product identity. Accurately render its transparency, yarn texture, subtle woven pattern, panel, rib, or jacquard structure. Keep the design elegant and visually clean, using fine textures and restrained patterns rather than dense florals, heavy fishnet, or complicated graphics. Use one consistent hosiery color with no gradient.

The hosiery must naturally follow the thighs, knees, calves, ankles, and feet with believable stretch and tension.

Place her in a real, ordinary, slightly worn concrete stairwell inside an apartment, office building, parking structure, or older urban building. Show rough gray concrete, worn stair edges, faint stains, scratches, patch repairs, pores, construction joints, and ordinary metal railings with visible use.

The stairwell should feel raw, functional, and genuinely used — not like a pristine brutalist showroom or studio-built concrete set.

Keep the skin genuinely photographic: visible pores, subtle tonal variation, tiny imperfections, slight natural redness, realistic knee and ankle tones, and natural lip texture. Hair should show individual strands, loose flyaways, and slight irregularity. Avoid poreless AI-beauty skin, waxy highlights, plastic smoothness, or excessive retouching.

Use a slightly low 50–70mm fashion-photography perspective to emphasize the full-body silhouette and elongated leg lines without extreme distortion. Use natural stairwell window light with soft directional fill, realistic contact shadows, and uneven brightness across the concrete surfaces.

prompts.text:
SYSTEM PROMPT: UMBRA RELAY

Rewrite the user's text, image, or both as a prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 or Nano Banana Pro. Use GPT unless Nano is named. Write in the user's language, preserve text, and keep the requested or source ratio.

Use three systems. Occlusion Core makes the subject block one dominant light source and remain readable through silhouette, posture, face planes, clothing, or structure. Escape Edge records where that source passes around hair, skin, fabric, glass, metal, or object rims. Site Return uses a location surface to send weaker light back into the shadow side.

Do not make a generic rim-lit portrait, night-city poster, or cutout. Determine the subject, source, blocking form, edge path, return surface, revealed planes, junctions, and a quiet region.

Preserve subject, count, identity, action, setting, clothing, objects, colors, text, and reference roles. For edits, preserve unrequested content. Use style references only for source occlusion, edge escape, underexposure, environmental return, crop, and depth. Do not copy faces, outfits, locations, or poses.

The source needs position, size, color, and direction. The subject blocks most of it. Edge light appears only on source-facing contours and breaks where hair density, anatomy, clothing, or objects interrupt it. No full glowing outline.

Return light comes from the setting and stays weaker than the source. It may reveal one eye, cheek, jaw, hand, garment plane, or object face. Water gives broken reflections. Stone gives broad low fill. Glass and metal give narrow highlights. Matte fabric absorbs most light. Skin keeps local color and does not glow.

Use one blocking anchor, one edge route, one return surface, one focal junction and a quiet area. Flare, haze, or light shafts require the source to enter the lens or particles to cross the beam.

Remove repetition, praise, mood labels, prestige terms, and unresolved alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, Occlusion Core, Escape Edge, Site Return, junctions, composition, preservation, text, and failures.

NANO: return JSON only, 1000 to 1800 tokens, using "aspect_ratio", "references", "scene", "subjects", "occlusion_core", "escape_edge", "site_return", "relay_junctions", "composition", "optics_and_material", "text", "avoid". Omit unused fields. No metadata, IDs, weights, comments, or repetition.

Return only the finished prompt.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography is made from a real physical material and behaves like that material.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Material: [PUFFER FABRIC / DENIM / MESH / CREAM / OTHER]
Material Behavior: [COMPRESS / TEAR / WEAVE / MELT / OTHER]
Subject / Product: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, bold high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame. Construct the letters from the chosen material with believable texture, thickness, seams, fibers, surface details, and lighting.

Most importantly, make the typography behave physically like the material. Fabric can compress and wrinkle, denim can tear and expose fibers, mesh can be threaded through eyelets, and frozen cream can soften and melt.

Let the subject or product interact directly with the material typography. Use realistic contact, pressure, tension, shadows, folds, tearing, or other material reactions so the effect feels physically connected rather than decorative.

Keep the main word readable even after the material transformation. Distort only the areas affected by the chosen behavior.

Use one dominant color system with a few contrasting accents. Add a small amount of meaningful campaign information such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, labels, or callouts.

The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, tactile, colorful, concept-driven, and visually complete.

Avoid generic “subject + big text” layouts, plastic-looking materials, random distortion, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, heavy CGI styling, clutter, and effects that do not match the chosen material.

生成一张高端商业 Editorial Design 海报，采用「夹缝构图 / Interval Composition」。

画面左右分别由两个尺度巨大的商业材质实体进入画幅，并被画面边缘裁切。两侧主体向中央挤压，在中间形成一条从顶部贯穿到底部的狭窄纵向负空间。中央负空间是整张海报真正的视觉主角。

裂隙不要完全笔直，可以呈缓慢自然的 S 型收放关系：顶部略宽，中部收紧，下部再次打开。内部保持干净、明亮、有空气感，不填入复杂背景。左右巨大材质使用【左侧巨大材质】与【右侧巨大材质】，重点表现真实的大尺度结构、连续纹理和高级商业材质感，不要让微小纹理压过整体构图。

始终遵循：先看到巨大材质关系，再看到主体细节。

两侧主体可以形成轻微差异，例如一侧更深、更重、更硬朗，另一侧更浅、更柔和、更透光，避免完全镜像。在中央负空间中下部加入【核心主体】，主体状态使用【主体位置与状态】。主体可以是产品，也可以是人物，但不要把中央空间完全塞满，主体上方必须保留足够空气，让“夹缝构图”依然清楚成立。

主体可以轻微越过中央负空间边界，与左右材质产生局部重叠或遮挡关系，让主体真正参与构图，而不是简单贴在中间。

使用大型英文 Serif Typography：【英文标题】标题横跨左右材质与中央负空间。

文字根据背景明暗自然切换深浅颜色：深色材质区域使用暖白或浅色文字，亮色裂隙区域使用深灰或深墨色文字。允许材质边缘或主体轻微遮挡部分字母，形成清楚的二维编辑层级，但保持整体可读。

中央负空间内部加入较小的纵向中文标题【主题】或对应中文概念词。中文使用纤细、克制、具有东方骨架的现代宋体或高级出版字体，不使用巨大毛笔书法。

加入品牌信息【品牌名】与产品名 / 系列名【产品名 / 系列名】，再搭配极少量辅助文案【辅助文案】。所有小字使用小字号散布在材质边缘或留白区域，不形成普通信息框，不加入无意义英文。

整体配色使用【主色调】，保持低饱和、克制、真实、高级。画面应具有品牌 Campaign、时尚杂志、商业海报、产品视觉与 Editorial Design 气质。

整体视觉公式：

- 左右巨大材质
- 中央纵向负空间
- 中下部核心主体
- 跨层大型 Typography
- 大面积低信息区域

最终效果必须让人在缩略图状态下依然首先看到“两侧巨大材质夹出一道明亮通道”，近看后才发现主体、材质细节、品牌信息与小型文字。

Let's start with the GPT 2.5 prompt for the initial image:

DIRECTIVE:
Produce one still that reads as an unpublished photograph taken by a working photographer. Optical capture, available physics, lived-in detail.

SUBJECT:
Three redneck cousins from rural Alabama, late twenties to mid forties, sitting on the rim of one giant black tractor inner tube floating on a reservoir: a huge heavy one with a sunburnt neck and a patchy beard, a wiry one with a farmer tan and a mullet under a faded camo trucker cap, a stocky one with a red mustache and wraparound sunglasses.
Each wears worn denim bib overalls over a bare chest, one strap hanging loose on the big one, denim soaked dark to the knees, frayed hems, bare wet feet resting inside the ring. A beer can in every hand.
Faces slack, heavy-lidded and dead serious, shoulders slumped, each one staring a different way: one at the grill, one at his can, one with his back half turned to the lens. All three relaxed, attention anywhere but the hole beside them.

ACTION / BEAT:
A quiet second of doing nothing. In the center of the tube a small round charcoal grill sits on a weathered plywood board, sending up a thin column of smoke that leans toward the spillway. One frayed yellow nylon rope runs taut from the tube to a fat knot around a fallen tree that slopes from the shore into the water, and it is the only thing holding the tube in place. A few yards behind them the reservoir pours over the round rim of a huge bell-mouth spillway, a perfectly circular hole swallowing a smooth curtain of water all the way around.
A caught moment.

SCENE:
A rural Alabama reservoir with a concrete bell-mouth spillway, the giant round drain hole dominating the middle of the water.
Early afternoon in late summer, hazy cloudless sky, still humid air.
A fallen pine with grey peeling bark and broken branch stubs lying from the red clay bank into the water; the stained concrete lip of the spillway with dark algae streaks; a dented blue beer can drifting near the tube; a sun-bleached orange warning buoy with flaking paint; a muddy shoreline with tire ruts, cattails and a crushed foam cup; a hazy pine treeline and the grey line of the dam on the far side.
A shoreline that has already been used.

COMPOSITION:
Shot type: long zoom
Angle: slight high, from the bank across the water
Placement: off-center, the spillway hole in the upper middle of the frame and visible in full, the tube just below and to the left of it, the fallen tree with the rope knot entering from the lower right
Look-room: right
Foreground: mild occlusion, blurred cattail blades and a rusted strand of fence wire cutting across the bottom left corner
Crop: handheld, slightly imperfect, horizon tilted a few degrees, lots of flat brown-green water around the small punched-in subjects.

CAMERA PACK:
Body: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
Lens / zoom: 10x periscope pushed to roughly 20x digital zoom
Aperture or phone mode: auto photo mode, handheld
Focus: sharp on the black tube and the three cousins, natural falloff behind
Film or sensor: computational JPEG with zoom mush, oversharpened edges and a faint heat shimmer over the water

LIGHT:
Source: high early-afternoon sun, slightly behind the camera's left shoulder
Quality: hard sun, flat and unflattering, bright glare on the water and on the wet rubber
Color temperature: warm daylight with a hazy, slightly green cast off the water
Shadows follow that source.

PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER:
Visible skin microtexture, pores, sunburn, faint uneven tone, slight facial asymmetry.
Flyaway hairs. Denim weave, seams, frayed straps, mud scuffs, cracked dusty rubber on the tube with a patched valve stem.
Sensor texture and compression smear that match the camera pack.
Catchlights only from the stated light.
Highlights a little hot, shadows a little closed.
Candid stance, catalog-unaware.

Then animate it using Seedance 2.5 and this prompt:

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Raw vertical smartphone video filmed by a bystander on the red clay bank of a rural Alabama reservoir, one continuous 30-second handheld take. Strong hand shake, clumsy digital zooms, hazy midday sun. Blurred cattails and barbed wire stay bottom left. The three men are loud, rowdy and never sit still. Real-time speed.

LOCKED SET: a huge round concrete spillway hole at the top, water always pouring over its whole rim into it, the lake flowing toward it; a fallen pine log from the right edge; one yellow rope from the tube to the log tip, the only thing holding it.
LOCKED CAST: three bare-chested men in denim bib overalls on the rim of one giant black tractor inner tube, beer cans in hand: a huge dark-bearded one on the left, a wiry one in a camo cap and mullet in the middle, a red-haired one in sunglasses on the right. A charcoal grill smokes mid-tube. One black cat, absent at second 0, walks in from the right edge at second 4.

Diegetic audio: falling water roar, grill sizzle, whooping, laughing, shouts in a Southern drawl, a heavy splash, the filmer's gasp.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
[ref_image] is the first frame and also the exact last frame: the clip is a perfect loop. It locks the men, tube, grill, rope, log, spillway and framing.

[TIMELINE]
0-4s: [HOOK - PARTY] Opens exactly as [ref_image]. The men clink cans and roar laughing, the big one tears into a rib off the grill, the red-haired one flings water at him. The phone punches a wobbly zoom into the spillway, then back out.
4-8s: [CAT ENTERS] A black cat walks in from the right edge along the log, tail up. The phone swings right and zooms in on it. The wiry one jumps to his feet, bouncing the tube, and hollers "Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!" while the others whoop and splash water at it.
8-11s: [SLASH] The cat stops over the taut yellow rope and with one claw swipe slices it clean through. Both ends whip away.
11-15s: [NO NO NO] Fast zoom out. The freed tube slides toward the hole. The men drop their cans, yell "No, no, no! Aw hell naw!" and paddle frantically backward with their hands.
15-20s: [SWALLOWED] The tube reaches the rim, spins once and plunges straight down INSIDE the spillway hole, the screaming men and the grill dropping down its throat until they vanish. The phone shakes hard.
20-23s: [SKY] As they vanish the phone zooms out fast and tilts up to the sky; the cat exits by the right edge. Empty sky; the tube enters at the frame's TOP edge and falls top to bottom, men and grill on it.
23-26s: [SPLASHDOWN] Tube, men and grill slam onto the water in their original spot. Huge splash.
26-30s: [LOOP] The splash settles fast and the men sit back down on the rim: same poses, same cans, the yellow rope tied taut to the log again, the cat gone, the phone in its starting position. The last frame is identical to [ref_image].

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Coherent water physics with real weight, stable faces and wardrobe. No subtitles, on-screen text or music.

And you are done! Hope you like it, waitng for yours in comments! 😎

A fallen pine with grey peeling bark and broken branch stubs lying from the red clay bank into the water; the stained concrete lip of the spillway with dark algae streaks; a dented blue beer can drifting near the tube; a sun-bleached orange warning buoy with flaking paint; a muddy shoreline with tire ruts, cattails and a crushed foam cup; a hazy pine treeline and the grey line of the dam on the far side.
A shoreline that has already been used.

COMPOSITION:
Shot type: long zoom
Angle: slight high, from the bank across the water
Placement: off-center, the spillway hole in the upper middle of the frame and visible in full, the tube just below and to the left of it, the fallen tree with the rope knot entering from the lower right
Look-room: right
Foreground: mild occlusion, blurred cattail blades and a rusted strand of fence wire cutting across the bottom left corner
Crop: handheld, slightly imperfect, horizon tilted a few degrees, lots of flat brown-green water around the small punched-in subjects.

CAMERA PACK:
Body: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
Lens / zoom: 10x periscope pushed to roughly 20x digital zoom
Aperture or phone mode: auto photo mode, handheld
Focus: sharp on the black tube and the three cousins, natural falloff behind
Film or sensor: computational JPEG with zoom mush, oversharpened edges and a faint heat shimmer over the water

LIGHT:
Source: high early-afternoon sun, slightly behind the camera's left shoulder
Quality: hard sun, flat and unflattering, bright glare on the water and on the wet rubber
Color temperature: warm daylight with a hazy, slightly green cast off the water
Shadows follow that source.

PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER:
Visible skin microtexture, pores, sunburn, faint uneven tone, slight facial asymmetry.
Flyaway hairs. Denim weave, seams, frayed straps, mud scuffs, cracked dusty rubber on the tube with a patched valve stem.
Sensor texture and compression smear that match the camera pack.
Catchlights only from the stated light.
Highlights a little hot, shadows a little closed.
Candid stance, catalog-unaware.

Then animate it using Seedance 2.5 and this prompt:

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Raw vertical smartphone video filmed by a bystander on the red clay bank of a rural Alabama reservoir, one continuous 30-second handheld take. Strong hand shake, clumsy digital zooms, hazy midday sun. Blurred cattails and barbed wire stay bottom left. The three men are loud, rowdy and never sit still. Real-time speed.

LOCKED SET: a huge round concrete spillway hole at the top, water always pouring over its whole rim into it, the lake flowing toward it; a fallen pine log from the right edge; one yellow rope from the tube to the log tip, the only thing holding it.
LOCKED CAST: three bare-chested men in denim bib overalls on the rim of one giant black tractor inner tube, beer cans in hand: a huge dark-bearded one on the left, a wiry one in a camo cap and mullet in the middle, a red-haired one in sunglasses on the right. A charcoal grill smokes mid-tube. One black cat, absent at second 0, walks in from the right edge at second 4.

Diegetic audio: falling water roar, grill sizzle, whooping, laughing, shouts in a Southern drawl, a heavy splash, the filmer's gasp.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
[ref_image] is the first frame and also the exact last frame: the clip is a perfect loop. It locks the men, tube, grill, rope, log, spillway and framing.

[TIMELINE]
0-4s: [HOOK - PARTY] Opens exactly as [ref_image]. The men clink cans and roar laughing, the big one tears into a rib off the grill, the red-haired one flings water at him. The phone punches a wobbly zoom into the spillway, then back out.
4-8s: [CAT ENTERS] A black cat walks in from the right edge along the log, tail up. The phone swings right and zooms in on it. The wiry one jumps to his feet, bouncing the tube, and hollers "Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!" while the others whoop and splash water at it.
8-11s: [SLASH] The cat stops over the taut yellow rope and with one claw swipe slices it clean through. Both ends whip away.
11-15s: [NO NO NO] Fast zoom out. The freed tube slides toward the hole. The men drop their cans, yell "No, no, no! Aw hell naw!" and paddle frantically backward with their hands.
15-20s: [SWALLOWED] The tube reaches the rim, spins once and plunges straight down INSIDE the spillway hole, the screaming men and the grill dropping down its throat until they vanish. The phone shakes hard.
20-23s: [SKY] As they vanish the phone zooms out fast and tilts up to the sky; the cat exits by the right edge. Empty sky; the tube enters at the frame's TOP edge and falls top to bottom, men and grill on it.
23-26s: [SPLASHDOWN] Tube, men and grill slam onto the water in their original spot. Huge splash.
26-30s: [LOOP] The splash settles fast and the men sit back down on the rim: same poses, same cans, the yellow rope tied taut to the log again, the cat gone, the phone in its starting position. The last frame is identical to [ref_image].

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Coherent water physics with real weight, stable faces and wardrobe. No subtitles, on-screen text or music.

And you are done! Hope you like it, waitng for yours in comments! 😎

TITLE: [insert title]
SUBJECT: [describe the model, outfit, hairstyle and pose]

Build the composition around the interaction between portrait photography and typography. The model should not simply stand beside the text. Make the typography physically participate in the image through overlap, masking, cropping, refraction, depth, foreground and background separation, or spatial interruption.

Use one strong visual mechanism per poster and make it immediately readable at thumbnail size.

Create a clear editorial hierarchy:

1. One oversized display title as the main graphic anchor
2. The fashion portrait as the primary photographic subject
3. A few meaningful editorial captions and credits

Large type can extend beyond the canvas and be partially hidden by the model. Small text should stay minimal, precise and meaningful rather than filling the page with random words.

Use an asymmetric editorial grid, bold cropping, generous negative space and strong scale contrast. Allow the model, type and graphic elements to move between foreground, middle ground and background.

Keep the palette restrained. Use mostly neutral tones such as ivory, soft gray, black or muted blue, with only one dominant accent color.

The portrait should feel like real fashion photography with natural skin texture, realistic fabric, believable hair and refined studio lighting. Avoid glossy CGI skin, excessive retouching and generic commercial modeling poses.

The final result should feel like an independent fashion magazine, experimental editorial campaign or art directed fashion poster, not a social media template.

Avoid meaningless filler text, excessive decoration, numbered labels, Vol or Issue numbering, sparkle symbols, random logos, cluttered layouts, cheap gradients and repetitive poster formulas.

SYSTEM PROMPT: UMBRA RELAY

Rewrite the user's text, image, or both as a prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 or Nano Banana Pro. Use GPT unless Nano is named. Write in the user's language, preserve text, and keep the requested or source ratio.

Use three systems. Occlusion Core makes the subject block one dominant light source and remain readable through silhouette, posture, face planes, clothing, or structure. Escape Edge records where that source passes around hair, skin, fabric, glass, metal, or object rims. Site Return uses a location surface to send weaker light back into the shadow side.

Do not make a generic rim-lit portrait, night-city poster, or cutout. Determine the subject, source, blocking form, edge path, return surface, revealed planes, junctions, and a quiet region.

Preserve subject, count, identity, action, setting, clothing, objects, colors, text, and reference roles. For edits, preserve unrequested content. Use style references only for source occlusion, edge escape, underexposure, environmental return, crop, and depth. Do not copy faces, outfits, locations, or poses.

The source needs position, size, color, and direction. The subject blocks most of it. Edge light appears only on source-facing contours and breaks where hair density, anatomy, clothing, or objects interrupt it. No full glowing outline.

Return light comes from the setting and stays weaker than the source. It may reveal one eye, cheek, jaw, hand, garment plane, or object face. Water gives broken reflections. Stone gives broad low fill. Glass and metal give narrow highlights. Matte fabric absorbs most light. Skin keeps local color and does not glow.

Use one blocking anchor, one edge route, one return surface, one focal junction and a quiet area. Flare, haze, or light shafts require the source to enter the lens or particles to cross the beam.

Remove repetition, praise, mood labels, prestige terms, and unresolved alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, Occlusion Core, Escape Edge, Site Return, junctions, composition, preservation, text, and failures.

NANO: return JSON only, 1000 to 1800 tokens, using "aspect_ratio", "references", "scene", "subjects", "occlusion_core", "escape_edge", "site_return", "relay_junctions", "composition", "optics_and_material", "text", "avoid". Omit unused fields. No metadata, IDs, weights, comments, or repetition.

@Image 1 defines the single female protagonist: preserve her facial identity, black bob with pink accents, black horns, lace headdress, cheek heart mark, piercings, black-and-white punk maid outfit, chains, and black bat wings. @Image 2 defines the environment: surreal Shibuya at blue hour, a monumental floating CRT television, wet reflective asphalt, urban architecture, atmospheric mist, and red-and-cyan luminous trails. Integrate the character naturally through matching light, reflections, shadows, and scale.
STORY:
She peels the black heart mark from her cheek, blows it into the giant television, and accidentally activates a beautiful psychedelic phenomenon. The heart returns as a tiny bat, lands on her cheek, and becomes the original heart mark again. Her confident expression briefly gives way to adorable disbelief.
OPENING COMPOSITION:
An eye-level medium shot, approximately waist-up, with her slightly left of center and the giant CRT clearly visible behind her on screen-right. Her face and cheek mark are easy to read. Soft light preserves natural skin tones; cyan and red light outline her hair, horns, chains, and wings. Use a consistent cinematic lens with natural perspective.

0.0–3.0 SECONDS:
Begin midway through a close foreground wing wipe: a black leather wing with red-and-cyan reflections moves left to right across the lens, clearing within the first quarter-second.
Reveal her already reaching toward the heart on her cheek. She delicately pinches it between thumb and index finger and lifts it off her skin as a tiny glossy black three-dimensional heart. The skin underneath is intact.
A subtle camera push makes this impossible gesture immediately readable. She gives a restrained, mischievous smile.
3.0–6.0 SECONDS:
She turns slightly toward the CRT, places the heart on her open palm, and blows it toward the screen.
The heart follows one clear curved trajectory, leaving a thin luminous ribbon.
The camera accelerates into a smooth lateral arc around her, then tracks the heart toward the television with strong foreground parallax and a brief low-angle sweep above the wet pavement. Controlled speed ramp, cinematic inertia, clear spatial continuity.

6.0–9.0 SECONDS:
The heart passes through the CRT glass like a droplet entering liquid.
The television’s nested neon rectangles blossom outward into an enormous rotating flower of translucent glass: recursive geometric petals, red-and-cyan interference patterns, delicate violet iridescence, and luminous depth extending impossibly inside the screen.
Reflected neon rises from the puddles as thin ribbons of liquid light, curling around the glass flower.
The camera rises smoothly along the edge of this structure, briefly slowing to reveal its exquisite detail. Keep the television’s outer casing and the city architecture physically recognizable.
9.0–12.5 SECONDS:
The same heart transforms into ONE tiny black bat inside the screen and flies back into the street.
A controlled whip-pan catches its return. The camera follows with a fast curved retreat toward the woman, resolving into the original frontal composition.
The bat lands gently on the originally marked cheek, folds its wings, and flattens into the exact original black heart mark.
The glass flower closes into the CRT, while the lifted reflections flow back into the puddles. The environment returns to its opening state.

12.5–15.0 SECONDS:
She briefly widens her eyes in silent disbelief, makes a tiny pout, then recovers her original cool expression.
Her hand returns toward the same cheek, ready to repeat the gesture.
The camera finishes at the exact opening position, height, lens, framing, focus, and exposure.
During the final quarter-second, the same wing sweeps left to right close across the lens. End on the same illuminated wing surface and matching motion phase seen at the beginning, so the physical wipe continues naturally across the loop boundary.

Premium live-action cinematography with tactile leather, fine lace, realistic skin, intricate metal reflections, and volumetric atmosphere.
Make the psychedelic spectacle feel like an impossible optical phenomenon occurring inside a real photographed city.
Use selective RGB separation, CRT scanlines, brief horizontal signal tears, and localized pixel displacement around the television and magical light trails. Add restrained analog video noise within the screen and subtle cinematic grain.
Keep her face, hands, anatomy, and costume stable and clearly readable throughout. Shape the visual rhythm around one spectacular transformation.

No background music, dialogue, or narration.
Quiet wet-city ambience, continuous low CRT hum, delicate chain movement, soft leather-wing sounds, an airy magical whoosh, glass-like resonance, brief electrical crackle, and tiny bat wingbeats.
Maintain continuous ambience across the loop boundary.
CONSTRAINTS:
One protagonist, one heart, one returning bat.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：如 Scent / Form / Motion / Hydration
【英文标题】：如 SCENT INTERVAL
【核心主体】：如香水 / 时装人物 / 运动鞋 / 精华瓶
【左侧巨大材质】：
【右侧巨大材质】：
【中央负空间氛围】：
【主体位置与状态】：
【品牌名】：
【产品名 / 系列名】：
【主色调】：
【辅助文案】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一张高端商业 Editorial Design 海报，采用「夹缝构图 / Interval Composition」。

画面左右分别由两个尺度巨大的商业材质实体进入画幅，并被画面边缘裁切。两侧主体向中央挤压，在中间形成一条从顶部贯穿到底部的狭窄纵向负空间。中央负空间是整张海报真正的视觉主角。

裂隙不要完全笔直，可以呈缓慢自然的 S 型收放关系：顶部略宽，中部收紧，下部再次打开。内部保持干净、明亮、有空气感，不填入复杂背景。左右巨大材质使用【左侧巨大材质】与【右侧巨大材质】，重点表现真实的大尺度结构、连续纹理和高级商业材质感，不要让微小纹理压过整体构图。

始终遵循：先看到巨大材质关系，再看到主体细节。

两侧主体可以形成轻微差异，例如一侧更深、更重、更硬朗，另一侧更浅、更柔和、更透光，避免完全镜像。在中央负空间中下部加入【核心主体】，主体状态使用【主体位置与状态】。主体可以是产品，也可以是人物，但不要把中央空间完全塞满，主体上方必须保留足够空气，让“夹缝构图”依然清楚成立。

主体可以轻微越过中央负空间边界，与左右材质产生局部重叠或遮挡关系，让主体真正参与构图，而不是简单贴在中间。

使用大型英文 Serif Typography：【英文标题】标题横跨左右材质与中央负空间。

文字根据背景明暗自然切换深浅颜色：深色材质区域使用暖白或浅色文字，亮色裂隙区域使用深灰或深墨色文字。允许材质边缘或主体轻微遮挡部分字母，形成清楚的二维编辑层级，但保持整体可读。

中央负空间内部加入较小的纵向中文标题【主题】或对应中文概念词。中文使用纤细、克制、具有东方骨架的现代宋体或高级出版字体，不使用巨大毛笔书法。

加入品牌信息【品牌名】与产品名 / 系列名【产品名 / 系列名】，再搭配极少量辅助文案【辅助文案】。所有小字使用小字号散布在材质边缘或留白区域，不形成普通信息框，不加入无意义英文。

整体配色使用【主色调】，保持低饱和、克制、真实、高级。画面应具有品牌 Campaign、时尚杂志、商业海报、产品视觉与 Editorial Design 气质。

整体视觉公式：

- 左右巨大材质
- 中央纵向负空间
- 中下部核心主体
- 跨层大型 Typography
- 大面积低信息区域

最终效果必须让人在缩略图状态下依然首先看到“两侧巨大材质夹出一道明亮通道”，近看后才发现主体、材质细节、品牌信息与小型文字。

避免：普通电商主图、主体居中塞满、复杂背景、满屏纹理、过多道具、强特效、水花火焰烟雾、促销信息、价格、二维码、复杂参数表、鲜艳配色、强 HDR、CGI 塑料感、3D Typography、无意义英文和过度装饰。
